Born at Little Compton 31 October 1692, son of William Southworth and Rebecca Pabodie.
A ship carpenter; moved to Mansfield, Connecticut, about 1720.
Around 1730 he sailed on a voyage to the Mediterranean to mend his fortunes and never came back.
Her grandmother Sarah Hooker was a daughter of Reverend Thomas Hooker, the founder of Hartford,
and her great-grandfather Reverend John Wilson was the first minister of Boston.
Left a widow with young sons, she taught the youngest, Constant, to read and write herself.
